maria: Heads-up — planning to deploy `feature/route-priority` to prod Wed 17:30 PT. Stagger by region (us-west -> eu -> apac). Looking for smoke owners and rollback readiness. ETA ~30m window. @ryan @sophia @dan :eyes:
ryan: I can take US-west smoke + rollback monitor. What's the canary size?
sophia: Recommend 5% canary, ~10 instances. Also suggest `--kv-cache-disabled` for first 5m to validate warmup. Smoke suite: infra/smoke/priority-suite.
dan: I'll own EU. Can cover APAC if we need to delay.
maria: awesome — @deploy-bot can you reserve a slot and pre-warm capacity for us? Need steady throughput of ~1200 tok/s during canary.
deploy-bot: [automated] Slot reserved for thread 1767778888. Reserved capacity: 2x standard canary pools in us-west; eu apac pending confirmation. See: https://console/releases/slots/1767778888 :white_check_mark:
sophia: Quick smoke checklist (copy into runbook):
```
- run `./scripts/smoke_priority.sh --region us-west`
- hit `/health` and `/v1/generate` 50 reqs, check p50/p95 latencies < 300ms / 800ms
- error-rate < 0.5% over 2 minutes
- verify cache logs contain `kv_cache: HIT` after warmup
- validate response schema + function-calling hooks
```
ryan: lgtm — I'll run the US-west smoke at T-15 and post logs here. :thumbsup:
maria: rollout config to enable auto-fallback if latency exceeds threshold for 2m: add to rollout YAML:
```
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  monitor:
    latency_threshold: 500ms
    duration: 2m
  fallback:
    model: redwood/small-quant:2026-01-12
    route: dedicated-fallback
```
sophia: noted — I'll open a small infra PR to update canary flags and the fallback config. Will ping for review.
ryan: PR #4829 posted for the release script and smoke job updates. @sophia pls review when you can.
sophia: Reviewing now — small nit on the timeout. I'll approve once adjusted.
maria: plan summary:
- 17:15 PT: preflight + US-west smoke (ryan)
- 17:30 PT: cut canary us-west
- 17:35 PT: EU smoke + cut canary (dan)
- 18:10 PT: APAC smoke + cut if OK (dan or standby)
If any smoke fails, immediate rollback to previous model and escalate to eng-oncall.
ryan: smoke pass @ 17:14 PT. No errors, p95 620ms. Logs: `smoke-id=prio-176` — uploading artifacts.
dan: EU ready, will start smoke at 17:35 PT. APAC hold until EU passes.
sophia: PR approved and merged — canary flags live.
maria: thanks team. Post the final pass/fail and timestamps here. If no blockers we'll cut full rollout at 18:30 PT after APAC stabilization. :rocket:
